name: Love Fetish ~Fellatio Hen~
original_name: らぶフェチ　～フェラチオ編～
source:
Miku's fascinating lips do not live up to aspirations. Ayumu seems to know the solution. She suggests using her as a cushion. With that the stronghold draws closer to its fall.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
美久的雙唇雖然迷人，結果卻不如預期。步似乎知道該怎麼辦，提議讓她充當墊子。如此一來，離攻陷這座堡壘又近了一步。
